$comment: Who may sign an app definition package. scripts/app-package-signature.mjs verify refuses a package signed by anyone else, before app-packages.yml publishes it and before the release candidate takes it (docs/business-apps/package-pipeline.md, section 9). A deployment may keep a copy of its own and give it with --trusted-signers. A github-workflow signer is trusted only for a run on its package's own tag, app-package/<name>/<version>, on GitHub's runners.
